reviewProfile: UX implementation, explicit browser assertions and visual review
scope: System conversation handoff to the existing application-preparation component. All interface scenarios intercept HTTP and keep synthetic fixtures isolated; no operational application, business record or agent result changed.

navigation.entry: Assistant in System context, or System > Conversations > Open System assistant
navigation.action: Prepare application / Follow preparation next to conversation
navigation.dialog: Native modal; header/context/return remain visible, one scroll area in body; existing nine-file preview and confirmations reused
navigation.recovery: The component remains mounted when the dialog closes. Shared original request and reason survive reload, persona changes and navigation to the repository page.

behaviorReviewed: System conversation is writable for authorized personas; planning generation/application/completion still require the Project destination and server capabilities.
Action observation comes from the current server response and is independent of message/history pages and the text of the model answer.

Complete or scoped metadata failures preserve the prior valid observation, mark freshness unavailable and block new preparation decisions. An incomplete initial or foreign-System descriptor cannot mount an actionable preparation panel.
Existing application-preparation APIs, idempotency, body, persona and durable requests are reused; opening/typing a message does not publish files or authorize merge.
Publication acknowledgment, queue and actual result remain distinct. Lost acknowledgment preserves original request identity and requires original persona for replay.
The same request can be recovered while the dialog is closed and reopened without writing tab=components into the assistant URL.
Draft release and merge retain the existing separate preparation confirmations. The existing preparation suite was rerun for this shared component change.
The local Conversations archive remains independent; its new scoped link opens the active System assistant.

Visual review caught inherited toolbar CSS making primary button text white on white despite passing click assertions. Scoped button styles now show the standard blue primary action; raw preliminary captures were preserved.

accessibility.asserted: Named dialog and controls; entry heading focus, preview focus, return focus, disabled decisions, role-based access and preserved drafts; viewport overflow asserted at 1440/390 in the new handoff scenario.
accessibility.visual: Six final viewport captures inspected: two review, two unavailable-observation and two uncertain-result recovery states. Five match the prior inspected capture byte for byte; the differing desktop recovery capture was inspected again from the final artifact.
limits: Full screen-reader certification, every keyboard path and browser/OS combinations were not exercised.
Viewport captures show the visible portion of the scrollable dialog, not a full expanded representation of every technical file.
Closed-toolbar entry has behavior assertions and is visible behind the recovery capture; no dedicated closed-entry screenshot is asserted here.

finalRuntimeRegression.failures: The two foreign-System cases used exact text matching for an error paragraph that also includes recovery text. The UI rejected the foreign descriptor; only the assertion was corrected, then the new twenty cases rerun.

combinedFinalRuntimeCoverage.method: Union by stable case ID of the 59-case final-runtime run and the twenty-case rerun; repeated cases are not added.

preliminary.limit: Before the final visual CSS and metadata-shape refinements; its workflow cases are historical regression evidence, not a claim that all 56 were reexecuted on the final source.

implementationLimits: No new deployment/runtime capability is implemented by this handoff. DEV target provisioning and deployment remain RA-12a/b/c.
No model tool calls, arbitrary shell/commands or action inferred as authorized from the wording of chat were introduced.
No full catalogue rerun or migration of all portal screens is claimed. No new indicators or targets.
